source.title: Адресный реестр объектов недвижимости города Москвы
source.embedded_terms: Типовые условия доступа к открытым данным органов власти в РФ

policy.purpose: Moscow-only official clean-address training/evaluation corpus; not bundled in the runtime package
filter: non-empty SIMPLE_ADDRESS, P7 street, and L1_VALUE house
policy.grouping: street/house/corpus/structure identity; SHA-256 groups are assigned 90% train, 5% validation, 5% test

limitations: The snapshot is from October 2021 and is not a current registry.
The corpus is Moscow-only and consists of clean legal formatting.
Only street, house, corpus, and structure are scored from SIMPLE_ADDRESS; administrative fields are intentionally out of scope for this view.
The archive is obtained from an attributed mirror; retain its embedded metadata and confirm redistribution terms before publishing derived rows.
